title: 12 Gifts Under $25 People Are Actually Buying (Black Friday 2026)
description: 12 gifts under $25 that keep topping this season's best-seller lists: small tech, cosy comforts, kitchen upgrades and self-care, each with the honest catch.
lede: Twelve small gifts that keep topping this season's best-seller lists, sorted by type and by who they're for, with the one thing to know before you buy each.

hero.alt: Christmas stockings hanging above a fireplace

ticker: One honest catch on every pick

people.lost: For the one who loses everything

top_picks.why: The one they'll use every day

bands.label: Small tech
bands.blurb: Useful gadgets that feel more expensive than they are.
bands.alt: Headphones and a phone on red and white stripes

items.name: Apple AirTag (2nd generation)
items.why: Clip it to keys, a bag or a suitcase and find it from an iPhone. A near-perfect gift they didn't know they needed.
items.catch: it only works with iPhones. For Android, choose a Samsung SmartTag or a Tile.

items.name: Anker Soundcore noise-cancelling earbuds
items.why: Noise cancelling, a transparency mode and around 10 hours of playtime at an easy gift price.
items.catch: budget noise cancelling softens a commute but won't match $200 earbuds.

items.name: Waterproof Bluetooth speaker
items.why: Waterproof, with a battery rated around 24 hours. Good for the shower, the beach or a teenager's room.
items.catch: small speakers fill a room, not a party.

bands.label: Cosy
bands.blurb: Winter comforts for the sofa, the commute and the cold.
bands.alt: A cosy winter scene with a warm drink

items.name: Rechargeable hand warmers
items.why: Reusable warmers that charge by USB. Thoughtful for commuters and anyone who watches outdoor sport.
items.catch: heat lasts a few hours per charge, not all day.

items.name: Wearable sherpa blanket
items.alt: Someone wrapped in a warm blanket
items.why: A hoodie-blanket hybrid with a big front pocket, and one of the most-gifted comfort items every winter.
items.catch: usually one-size and bulky; it's for the sofa, not for going out.

items.name: Yankee Candle Balsam & Cedar
items.why: A classic winter scent with a long burn time. A safe pick for a colleague or host.
items.catch: the scent is strong, so skip it for anyone sensitive to fragrance.

bands.label: Kitchen
bands.blurb: Everyday upgrades for people who cook and host.
bands.alt: A coffee machine in a sunny kitchen

items.name: Dash hot-air popcorn maker
items.why: Makes a big bowl of popcorn without oil in a couple of minutes. Fun for movie-night families.
items.catch: air-popped corn is dry, so seasoning won't stick without a little butter or oil spray.

items.name: Bamboo cutting board set (3 pieces)
items.alt: A wooden cutting board and knife
items.why: Three sizes with juice grooves. An everyday upgrade for anyone who cooks.
items.catch: bamboo is hand-wash only and needs oiling now and then.

items.name: French press coffee maker
items.alt: A French press with fresh coffee
items.why: Rich coffee with no machine or pods. Add a bag of local coffee for a complete gift.
items.catch: it needs coarse-ground coffee, or you'll get grit in the cup.

bands.label: Self-care
bands.blurb: Small treats for the bathroom shelf and the carry-on.
bands.alt: Colourful beauty bottles on a shelf

items.name: Laneige Lip Sleeping Mask minis
items.alt: A small jar of balm on a wooden stand
items.why: Mini overnight lip masks in several flavours. A cult favourite at a gift-friendly price.
items.catch: the minis are small, so heavy users will finish them fast.

items.name: Mighty Patch Original
items.why: Hydrocolloid patches that are one of the most popular stocking fillers for teens and adults.
items.catch: check the pack size; the cheapest packs have only a few patches.

items.name: Bagsmart toiletry bag
items.why: Separate wet and dry compartments in water-resistant fabric. It turns up on gift lists year after year.
items.catch: it's roomy, so it may be too big for a carry-on-only traveller.

method: We cross-checked this season's best-seller and editors' gift lists (November 2026) and kept items that appear repeatedly, have strong buyer reviews and suit a wide range of people. Prices were checked on 11 November 2026 and change daily around Black Friday, so check the price before you buy. We only call something a deal when we've seen the price drop.
updates: 11 November 2026: redesigned with photos; Amazon links now go through our Associates account.
more_html: 11 gift ideas for her under $60.
